news.hl: Thousands join Marathon Kids Kickoff across NYC
news.detail: Thousands of young runners are participating in the TCS New York City Marathon Kids Kickoff across all five boroughs, celebrating the 50th anniversary of the original 5-boro New York City Marathon.
